message: You really think you're some kind of moral superhero, don't you? Standing up for the "unborn" like they're some kind of tiny, helpless victims. Meanwhile, you're too busy demonizing women who make the choice to have an abortion to actually listen to their stories or understand their circumstances. You're not just anti-abortion, you're anti-choice, and you're anti-women's rights. Your whole stance is predicated on the idea that women are too stupid or too weak to make their own decisions, and that the only way to "save" them is to take away their autonomy. It's not feminism, it's misogyny. And as for your claim that the pro-abortion lobby wants to erase the humanity of the unborn, well, that's just a ridiculous straw man. If you actually cared about the lives of these children, you'd be fighting for better access to healthcare, education, and economic opportunities for the families that already exist. But no, you're too busy trying to shame and control women to actually do anything about poverty, hunger, and inequality. So, go ahead and keep playing the victim, because that's all you're doing - playing the victim of your own biases and prejudices.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 'anti-choice', 'anti-women's rights', and 'misogynistic'.  Also labels their stance as 'predicated on the idea that women are too stupid or too weak to make their own decisions'.
